# FnCalcs

> A collection of free online financial calculators for investment growth, loans, and analysis with interactive charts.

## Investment Calculators
- [Compound Interest](https://fncalcs.com/compound-interest-calculator.html): Calculate long-term investment growth.
- [Simple Interest](https://fncalcs.com/simple-interest-calculator.html): Basic interest calculation tool.
- [Savings Goal](https://fncalcs.com/savings-goal-calculator.html): Plan your savings target over time.

## Loan Calculators
- [Loan Calculator](https://fncalcs.com/loan-calculator.html): Determine monthly payments and interest costs.

## Analysis Tools
- [ROI Calculator](https://fncalcs.com/roi-calculator.html): Measure investment returns.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://fncalcs.com/CAGR-calculator.html): Calculate compound annual growth rate.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://fncalcs.com/privacy.html): Details on data use and privacy practices.
